system.description:
An enemy’s soul is just another weapon to be turned against them. The Eidolon of Rage bends the veil so that no wall, no ally, and no crowd can shield a marked foe from your wrath. You hurl fire or lightning through a Soul Touched enemy and rend them apart.

LEVEL 3

Soul of Rage. Cast a spell at a Soul Touched target regardless of obstructions; the spell targets only that Soul Touched (ignoring AoE/multi-target) and removes Soul Touched. You learn to cast spells from either the Fire or Lightning School, and Ruin can deal Cold or Fire/Lightning damage.

Rage Rites. A Rite menu (Defile, Shelter) that spends Soul Touched to sharpen your spells.

LEVEL 7

Spirit Siphon. Soul of Rage spells are cast as if 1 tier higher (max tier 5).

LEVEL 11

Raging Ruin. Ruin can strike the target and all adjacent enemies.

LEVEL 15

Destruction. (1/round) Soul of Rage spells gain a bonus equal to your soul power (not HP-restoring spells).
